inputs.change_step.description.value: Grid step of the change cue on the thresholded level, in pixels.

inputs.change_threshold.description.value: A frame whose mean absolute grey change from the previous frame (sampled pixels) exceeds this is a full search; 0 turns the cue off.

inputs.constant_velocity.description.value: Predict tracks with constant velocity; false keeps their last corners.

inputs.downscale_missing.description.value: When the frame carries no companion at `pyramid_level`: true box-downscales the frame in the node, false thresholds the full frame.

inputs.dp_fraction_x1000.description.value: Douglas-Peucker tolerance as a fraction of the contour perimeter, in thousandths.

inputs.dp_min_x100.description.value: Smallest Douglas-Peucker tolerance, in hundredths of a pixel.

inputs.end_tracks_leaving_frame.descript.value: Recovery: a missed track whose prediction leaves the frame ends without a search.

inputs.error_correction_percent.descript.value: Corrected bits allowed, in percent of the dictionary's maximum, rounded down.

inputs.full_search.description.value: Search this frame in full (on demand); the track table is kept.

inputs.full_search_every.description.value: Search the whole frame at least every this many frames (N); new tags are found at most N - 1 frames after they appear.

inputs.hull_fallback_min_side.descriptio.value: Contours from this bounding-box side on that Douglas-Peucker leaves with 5 to 8 vertices are retried on the hull of those vertices; 0 turns it off.

inputs.invert.description.value: Mark pixels darker than the local mean (marker borders) as foreground.

inputs.loss_escalation_change.descriptio.value: Recovery: a blind miss brings on its full search only on a frame whose change measure is at least this (the scene moved); 0 escalates on every blind miss.

inputs.loss_full_search_after.descriptio.value: Recovery: a full search follows the tracked frame on which a track reaches this many consecutive misses; 0 never escalates.

inputs.loss_search.description.value: What a missed track brings on: off, a full search the next frame, the same frame again in full, or staged recovery (a widened window on the same frame, a full search only after loss_full_search_after misses).

inputs.margin_growth_misses.description.value: The window margin grows per miss, and recovery's widened window applies, for at most this many misses.

inputs.max_border_error_percent.descript.value: Largest share of border cells, in percent, that may read bright.

inputs.max_correction_bits.description.value: Most bits the decoder corrects; -1 uses the dictionary's own maximum.

inputs.max_missed_frames.description.value: A track missed on more than this many consecutive frames is dropped; until then its window is searched every frame, so a tag lost for a few frames is found again the frame it is back.

inputs.max_radius.description.value: Upper bound of the first-pass radius, in pixels.

inputs.max_tracks.description.value: Most tracks held (the track table is allocated for this many); tags past it are reported on full searches only.

inputs.min_contrast.description.value: Smallest luma difference between the mean bright and mean dark cells.

inputs.min_corner_distance_permille.desc.value: Smallest distance between neighbouring corners, in per mille of the perimeter; 0 turns the gate off.

inputs.min_distance_to_border.descriptio.value: Smallest distance of every corner from the frame edge, in pixels.

inputs.min_height.description.value: Smallest bounding-box height of a candidate.

inputs.min_perimeter_permille.descriptio.value: Smallest quad perimeter, in per mille of the frame's larger dimension; 0 turns the gate off.

inputs.min_points.description.value: Fewest contour points of a candidate.

inputs.min_radius.description.value: Lower bound of the first-pass radius, in pixels.

inputs.min_step.description.value: Weakest accepted edge step, as the luma difference across one pixel.

inputs.min_width.description.value: Smallest bounding-box width of a candidate.

inputs.offset.description.value: Subtracted from the local mean before comparing.

inputs.polish_radius.description.value: Radius of the second, polishing pass; 0 skips it.

inputs.prediction_horizon_frames.descrip.value: Constant-velocity prediction extrapolates at most this many frames past the last sighting.

inputs.pyramid_level.description.value: Pyramid level to threshold: 0 is the full frame, 1 the half-size level, 2 the quarter-size one.

inputs.radius.description.value: Window radius in pixels; the mean window is `2 * radius + 1` wide.

inputs.recovery_margin_scale.description.value: Recovery: the widened window's margin, as a multiple of the track's normal margin.

inputs.refine_weak.description.value: Refine the corners of weak decodes and decode them again.

inputs.require_convex.description.value: Reject quads that are not strictly convex.

inputs.require_dark_border.description.value: Reject quads whose sampled border is mostly bright (Otsu level) before the dictionary lookup.

inputs.roi_margin.description.value: Window margin around a track's predicted corners, in full-frame pixels, times one plus the frames it has been missed.

inputs.roi_margin_side.description.value: Window margin as a fraction of the tag's mean side.

inputs.roi_margin_velocity.description.value: Window margin as a fraction of the predicted corner travel since the last sighting.

inputs.sampler.description.value: How each bit cell is read and thresholded.

inputs.search_rate.description.value: First-pass search radius as a fraction of the side length.

inputs.solid_max_side.description.value: Skip components without a hole whose larger bounding-box side reaches this; 0 traces all.

inputs.threshold.description.value: Fixed threshold of the fixed-threshold samplers, and the fallback of the adaptive ones.

inputs.window_threshold_offset.descripti.value: Adaptive-mean offset of the window searches (tracked passes and recovery); full search keeps the mask offset.

inputs.refine_iterations.description.value: Levenberg-Marquardt steps refining each pose in the distorted image; 0 keeps the IPPE poses.

inputs.tag_size_m.description.value: Edge length of the marker's black square, in the unit the translations come out in (metres by convention).

summary.value: ArUco/AprilTag tag pose (pinhole or fisheye lens) from refined or decoded corners

inputs.huber_delta_px.description.value: Huber threshold of the joint refinement, in pixels.

inputs.inlier_threshold_px.description.value: A tag whose corners the joint pose misses by more than this root mean square, in pixels, is an outlier.

inputs.joint_iterations.description.value: Levenberg-Marquardt steps of each joint refinement over all tags.

inputs.min_inlier_tags.description.value: Fewest inlier tags of a valid pose.

inputs.tag_refine_iterations.description.value: Levenberg-Marquardt steps refining each tag's own pose.

summary.value: Camera pose in the reference frame of known ArUco/AprilTag tag poses (pinhole or fisheye lens)
